prompt: Implement split_bill(total_cents, weights) in solution.py. Split total_cents among parties in proportion to the integer weights. Return a list of integer cents, one per weight, that sums exactly to total_cents. Use the largest remainder method. Give each party the floor of its exact share, then hand out the leftover cents one at a time to the parties with the largest fractional remainder, breaking ties by lower index. Run python -m pytest -q test_visible.py.

+def split_bill(total_cents: int, weights: list[int]) -> list[int]:
+    if not weights:
+        return []
+
+    total_weight = sum(weights)
+
+    # Calculate floor shares and remainders
+    shares = []
+    remainders = []
+
+    for weight in weights:
+        exact_share = (total_cents * weight) / total_weight
+        floor_share = int(exact_share)
+        remainder = exact_share - floor_share
+
+        shares.append(floor_share)
+        remainders.append(remainder)
+
+    # Calculate leftover cents
+    leftover = total_cents - sum(shares)
+
+    # Distribute leftover to parties with largest remainders (breaking ties by lower index)
+    remainder_with_index = [(remainders[i], i) for i in range(len(weights))]
+    remainder_with_index.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]))
+
+    # Give leftover cents to top parties
+    for i in range(leftover):
+        idx = remainder_with_index[i][1]
+        shares[idx] += 1
+
+    return shares
